title: Lesson 4 Checkpoint — Demonstratives
description: Show what you learned about demonstratives. You need at least 4 out of 5 correct to pass.
canDo: I can point to things near and far using this, that, these, and those.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Demonstratives: This/these = near the speaker. That/those = farther away. Match number: this/that + singular verb; these/those + plural

questions.question: Complete: This ___ a pen.
